summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is identifier-mangled (javascript-obfuscator-style `_0x` names with per-function object-lookup indirection tables) and, on install, checks for a local Bun binary; if absent it downloads a Bun release archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13, extracts the `bun` binary to a temporary directory, chmods it 0755, and uses it to execute the shipped `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, string-array rotator `WV8StW`, mangled identifiers, single large numeric constant table `n7gIxM`) unrelated to the package's advertised chatbot-API-client purpose. Executing the payload under a separately-fetched Bun runtime routes the code around Node's module graph and standard tooling, and it runs with the installer's user privileges on every `npm install`. Native-client code additionally issues `ping` and multiple hardcoded `POST` calls (dist/api-client/titan-chat/native-client.js). The combination of a lifecycle-hook alternate-runtime dropper, an obfuscated install script, and an opaque obfuscated bundle executed under that runtime is the install-time RCE pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
